text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Matikanetannhauser 
storming out of 
the academy with steam practically puffing 
from her nose—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, wish me luck! 
I'm off to save my family diner in its 
hour of need!
choice_data_list: Good luck! I'm sure it'll all work out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Dad, Mom! 
I'm hoooome!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser?! 
What's the matter? You didn't even call 
ahead...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Never mind that, never mind that! 
We can talk later! I'm borrowing the 
kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
S-Sure...? 
Be careful, okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The dining area was totally empty... 
So what they said about the menu being 
hopeless is true.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
In that case, all I gotta do is come up 
with a brand-new 
dish to bring the customers flocking back!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, Dad, Mom. 
I'm gonna save our diner from doom!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Order up! 
It's my Healthy Tomato Malatang!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
Let's see here... Mmm, the sour and spicy 
flavors are in perfect balance!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer
text_block_list.text:
Oho, home cooking from little Machi? 
Mind if I get a bowl of that too?

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! This is fantastic! 
The vinegar pairs with it like a charm!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Really?! Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
With a reaction like that, 
new customers are sure to come flooding 
in!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So... you can't give up! 
Dad, Mom!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
With this new menu item, we can keep the 
diner open!!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
Right on, Tannhauser! 
...Wait, what are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Dad, you said it yourself...! 
That our menu is totally done for!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... Could she be talking about what 
you said earlier? 
About wanting to replace the old menu 
pamphlets?

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah. I just meant that our printed 
menus are so battered 
that they're ready for the trash, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Then why is the diner so 
deserted?! 
It's always packed at this time of day—

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
We have a large group reservation later, 
so we took an early break today. 
We'd never even dream of closing down.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: N-N-No—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No waaaayyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Dad, Mom... I'm so sorry. 
I shouldn't have jumped to the worst 
conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: More importantly, Tannhauser, you—

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
This is incredible! 
To think you've learned to make food like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? 
You think so...? I just made it the way I 
was taught.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
That's plenty impressive. 
Back when you lived at home, this was 
unthinkable.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
It has tomato juice in it, even though you 
don't like it. 
You must have powered through the taste 
tests, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Your hands are chapped, too. You must have 
practiced so much, didn't you? 
Hehe, you're our pride and joy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Dad, Mom...! 
Yeah... I worked super hard!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I still mess up, and I cause trouble for 
everyone! 
But, but I still tried my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we know. And we won't let this 
malatang 
go to waste either. Let's make it our 
signature dish!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You're right. We need to liven up the 
diner even more. 
Will you teach us how to make it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! 
Leave it to me, Dad, Mom!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After work, I took a little detour to 
visit a diner 
rumored to serve delicious food—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Welcoooome! 
Ah, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Wait, is this your family's diner...!?
Wait, this is your family's place...!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yup, it's my beloved family diner! 
What would you like to order!
